---
title: "Crab salad"
date: 2021-03-22
tags: ['salad', 'russian']
---

![Crab salad](/pix/crab-salad.webp)

- ⏲️ Prep time: 10 min
- 🍳 Cook time: 30 min
- 🍽️ Servings: 3

## Ingredients

- Сrab meat (300 grams)
- Egg (3)
- Rice (50 grams)
- Corn (1 can)
- Cucumber (1)
- Carrot (1)
- Onion (1)
- Mayonnaise (100 grams)

## Directions

1. Boil rice, eggs and carrot
2. Chop crab meat and all other ingredients
3. Combine and mix all ingredients
4. Add mayonnaise
5. Chill before serving
